passages.text: Our history club visits a workshop where a guide demonstrates an old candle holder. He asks us not to get close to the flame, even when we want a better view. Mia watches from the marked line and sketches the shape without leaning over the table. At the end, the guide must blow out the candle before moving the holder to the display shelf. We wait until he confirms that it is safe, then ask about the handle and the broad base. The visit shows that questions and careful observation can continue without stepping into a risky space.

parallelText.en: Our history club visits a workshop where a guide demonstrates an old candle holder.
parallelText.zh: 我们历史社参观一间作坊，一位向导向我们演示旧烛台的用法。

parallelText.en: He asks us not to get close to the flame, even when we want a better view.
parallelText.zh: 他请我们不要靠近火焰，即使想看得更清楚。

parallelText.en: Mia watches from the marked line and sketches the shape without leaning over the table.
parallelText.zh: 米娅在标记线外观察，不探身到桌上便画出形状。

parallelText.en: At the end, the guide must blow out the candle before moving the holder to the display shelf.
parallelText.zh: 结束时，向导必须吹灭蜡烛，再把烛台移到展架。

parallelText.en: We wait until he confirms that it is safe, then ask about the handle and the broad base.
parallelText.zh: 我们等他确认安全后，再询问把手和宽底座。

parallelText.en: The visit shows that questions and careful observation can continue without stepping into a risky space.
parallelText.zh: 这次参观说明，不进入危险区域，也可以继续提问与仔细观察。

passages.text: Our school keeps a small indoor display space open all year round, not only during special fairs. Each month, a different class chooses one project to explain there. Today, we pass around a booklet showing how our bridge model changed during testing. Visitors compare the first sketch with a later photograph and ask why we added another support. Mia explains the test result, then invites them to write questions on cards beside the booklet. Because the space stays available between events, other classes can return and build on the discussion later.

parallelText.en: Our school keeps a small indoor display space open all year round, not only during special fairs.
parallelText.zh: 学校有一个全年开放的小室内展区，不只在特别集市时开放。

parallelText.en: Each month, a different class chooses one project to explain there.
parallelText.zh: 每个月由不同班级选择一个项目在那里讲解。

parallelText.en: Today, we pass around a booklet showing how our bridge model changed during testing.
parallelText.zh: 今天，我们传阅一本小册子，介绍桥梁模型在测试中怎样变化。

parallelText.en: Visitors compare the first sketch with a later photograph and ask why we added another support.
